repair_feedback: Repair the two critical cross-lane integration defects (F1+F2) that block the product's central schedule-application flow from SHA ec916b75d5600e02d679d264648ac92333d721f1. The platform apply-plan endpoint correctly enforces Contract §9.2 (body must be exactly { confirmedDiffHash }; inline plans rejected), but (a) no production ConfirmedPlanLookup implementation or POST /confirm-diff registration endpoint exists anywhere in the repository (F2), and (b) the dashboard bridge sends { ops, confirmedDiffHash } which the endpoint rejects with 400 (F1). Both must be repaired together for the apply flow to function. Integration lane owns the platform HTTP layer and must: (1) add a ConfirmedPlanStore interface extending ConfirmedPlanLookup with a register(ref) method; (2) implement an in-memory production ConfirmedPlanStore (Map-backed, bound to app-lifetime scope); (3) add a POST /confirm-diff endpoint handler in mutationEndpoints.ts that accepts { confirmedDiffHash, plan: MutationPlan, confirmedBy: string }, validates body shape strictly, writes the ConfirmedPlanReference via the store, and returns { confirmedDiffHash }; (4) export the new endpoint, types, and store from src/platform/http/index.ts; (5) update src/platform/http/README.md endpoint map with the new row; (6) wire the ConfirmedPlanStore instance in the composition root (src/platform/composition/index.ts) so both confirm-diff and apply-plan share the same backing store; (7) add platform-layer tests (tests/platform/http-mutations.spec.ts or new spec) covering: confirm-diff happy path, confirm-diff body validation (rejects extra keys, missing fields), confirm-diff idempotency (same hash re-registration), confirm-then-apply round-trip, apply without prior confirm returns NOT_FOUND, apply with stale/replaced hash still resolves correctly; (8) include a cross-lane coordination note for the dashboard lane: bridge.requestApply must drop the ops parameter (send only { confirmedDiffHash }), a new bridge.confirmDiff(confirmedDiffHash, plan) method must call POST /confirm-diff, and rulesEditorPage.handleApply must call confirmDiff before requestApply. The integration candidate must not modify dashboard files; the dashboard bridge fix is a separate downstream task but the task description must make the contract explicit so the auditor can verify cross-lane consistency.
